notes.title: Patch 1.02
notes.content:
Hello!

After the feedback about translation issues, I made a review with my teacher and today I've released a new English version. Besides that, I moved the wood close to the stream (Kimchi Tea and Miraakles feedback - Thank you guys!). All versions are updated. 

If you have more suggestions, please, feel free to help me.

notes.title: Sick Love in China and Good News!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Thank you so much for supporting Male Doll. When I started to create games with LGBTQ+ protagonists, I never thought my projects could be bought in the USA, Germany, Russia, Japan, and many other countries. I’m deeply grateful, so thank you all (again)!  At last but not least, I have some good news:

[list]
[*]  Sick Love will have a Traditional Chinese translated version soon;
[*]  I’m working on my next Yaoi Game with Gay Sexual Content (nudity);
[/list]

See you soon! <3
